info.description:
Use the TGP API to submit trader goods-profile records to the Trader Goods
Profile Service (TGP).

The [Trader goods profile service
guide](/guides/trader-goods-profile-service-guide/) contains a detailed
overview of v1.0 of the API.

get.description: Gets a list of good records

parameters.description: Specifies the response format and the [version](/api-documentation/docs/reference-guide#versioning) of the API to be used.
parameters.name: Accept

parameters.description: An OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token.
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.description: The traders' EORI number. The first 2 letters are the country code, like GB followed by 12 to 15 digits.
parameters.name: eori

schema.description: The traders' EORI number. The first 2 letters are the country code, like GB followed by 12 to 15 digits.

parameters.description: Date value, all records after which have to be retrieved from the backend; This should use standard ISO8601 format (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ssZ).
parameters.name: lastUpdatedDate

parameters.description: The page number to fetch, defaults to 0
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Number of records per page to be requested, default is 500
parameters.name: size

schema.description: Number of records per page to be requested

recordId.description: ID of the record for the TGP Product in the TGP Core database (UUID)

eori.description: The traders' EORI number. The first 2 letters are the country code, like GB followed by 12 to 15 digits.

actorId.description: EORI number of the user making the change. This may be different to the eori. The first 2 letters are the country code, like GB or XI followed by 12 to 15 digits.

traderRef.description: Unique product reference traders use to identify the goods. For example a Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code. If the trader does not provide a traderRef, the front end should duplicate the goodsDescription field and pass this as traderRef.

comcode.description: A code specific to goods that must be 6, 8, or 10 digits long. Only numeric values are allowed.

adviceStatus.description: Indicates the advice status of a record if the trader has requested that HMRC review their commodity code.

goodsDescription.description: A description of the goods that the trader can choose. This field does not need to be unique.

countryOfOrigin.description: Country where the product came from. This is a char field with 2 letters in it as per ISO 3166 standards. You can also refer to CDS Appendix 13 [Country codes for the Customs Declaration Service](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/country-codes-for-the-customs-declaration-service).

category.description: To be retrieved using the Online Trade Tariff API. The category of the goods based on applicable restrictions, prohibitions or any exemptions the trader may hold.

assessments.description: Array of category assessment data describing the measures which apply to the trader's movement of goods, and how the trader is exempt (if applicable).

assessmentId.description: The ID of the category assessment(s) retrieved from the  [Trade Tariff Green Lanes API](https://api.trade-tariff.service.gov.uk/green-lanes.html#get-green-lanes-category-assessments)

primaryCategory.description: The primary category of the assessment

condition.description: A collection of data detailing the condition the trader meets to exempt the category assessment

type.description: The type of condition/exemption as provided by the  [Trade Tariff Green Lanes API](https://api.trade-tariff.service.gov.uk/green-lanes.html#get-green-lanes-category-assessments)

conditionId.description: The ID/code of the condition as provided by the  [Trade Tariff Green Lanes API](https://api.trade-tariff.service.gov.uk/green-lanes.html#get-green-lanes-category-assessments)

conditionDescription.example: Products not considered as waste according to Regulation (EC) No 1013/2006 as retained in UK law
conditionDescription.description: The description of the condition as provided by the  [Trade Tariff Green Lanes API](https://api.trade-tariff.service.gov.uk/green-lanes.html#get-green-lanes-category-assessments)

conditionTraderText.description: A free text statement provided by the trader if required in the CDS guidance

supplementaryUnit.description: Supplementary units are sometimes needed on H8 declarations and provide a quantity of goods in a specified unit of measurement.

measurementUnit.description: Measurement units define the required unit of measure when a supplementary unit is needed on an H8 declaration. Measurement units are defined in the [Trade Tariff commodities API measurement documentation.](https://api.trade-tariff.service.gov.uk/reference-data.html#measurement-units)

comcodeEffectiveFromDate.description: Date in the Online Tariff Tool (OTT) when authorised usage of a commodity code came into effect.

comcodeEffectiveToDate.description: Date in the OTT when authorised usage of a commodity code expired or will expire.

toReview.description: The state of the record and if the trader needs to review it.

reviewReason.example: The commodity code has expired. You'll need to change the commodity code and categorise the goods.
reviewReason.description:
The commodity code has expired. You'll need to change the commodity code and categorise the goods.

The country of origin is not valid. You'll need to change the country of origin and categorise the record.

The commodity code or restrictions have changed. You'll need to categorise the record.

HMRC have reviewed the record. The goods description is unclear. If you want to use this record on an IMMI, you'll need to amend the goods description.

HMRC have reviewed this record. The goods description does not have enough detail. If you want to use this record on an IMMI, you'll need to amend the goods description.

HMRC have reviewed this record. The commodity code and goods description do not match. If you want to use this record on an IMMI, you'll need to amend the commodity code and the goods description.
